scan_client_qr_first: Scan the QR code shown by the client to hand over the cash.
confirm_requires_scan: The client's QR code must be scanned before the handover.
signer_declared_name: Name of the person signing (as declared)
align_qr: Align the QR code in the frame
verify_identity: Verify the beneficiary identity before payment
signature_instruction: The beneficiary signs here with finger
signature_too_short: Signature too short, please sign again
invalid_qr: Invalid QR Code - Payment not found
not_cash_payment: This QR code is not a Cash payment

camera_not_found: No camera detected on this device.
camera_in_use: Camera is in use by another app. Close other apps and try again.

rc_choose_location_hint: The place decides the shipping mode of the parcels you receive. You can change it on the home screen.
rc_no_deposit_today: No drop-off yet today. The first parcel that arrives goes here.
rc_scan_hint: Scan the customer's QR in their app, a Bonzini label, or the courier waybill.
rc_waybill_kept: It will be kept on the parcel. Find the customer, or record without.
rc_by_courier_hint: SF, YTO, ZTO… sent by a supplier
rc_by_client_hint: Back from the market with their goods
rc_by_representative_hint: A relative, an employee, an agent
rc_by_pickup_hint: At the market or the supplier's
rc_sup_help: The supplier or buying agent: on the courier waybill, or on our label (section 4).
rc_no_parcel_yet: No parcel yet. Add the first one.
rc_done_receipt: The receipt is in the customer's app.
rc_pending_hint: Parcels received without knowing whose they are. Call back, or wait for the customer to come forward.
rc_missing_hint: Weight, dimensions or photo missing: you can go on, but the invoice will need them.
rc_close_hint: Totals are frozen and the receipt goes to the customer. No more parcels can be added.
rc_camera_off: Camera unavailable: type the name or number below.
rc_labels_hint: One label per parcel, with its number. Stick one on each.
rc_code_unknown: Unknown code: no customer has this code
rc_retake_hint: Tap the photo to retake it
rc_tap_to_edit: Tap a parcel to complete or correct it.
rc_client_label_hint: The supplier sticks it on every carton. On arrival, one scan links the parcel to the customer.
rc_mode_sea_hint: By sea. The supplier delivers to our Guangzhou warehouse.
rc_mode_air_hint: By air. The supplier delivers to our Guangzhou office.
rc_address_missing: The address for this mode is not set yet by the team.
rc_no_deposits_yet: No drop-off for this customer yet.
rc_label_error: Could not generate the label. Try again.
rc_no_client_yet: No customer yet. Search by name, phone or code.
rc_s1_help: The QR in their app, or a Bonzini label. Hold it inside the frame.
rc_search_help: Type their name, phone or BZ code.
rc_s2_help: One answer. You can continue right after.
rc_s3_title: Add the parcels, one by one
rc_s3_help: One parcel at a time: photo, weight, dimensions. Then "Finish".
rc_p_photo_title: Take a photo of the parcel
rc_p_photo_help: Proof of what arrived. Tap the area to open the camera.
rc_p_weight_help: In kilos. Put it on the scale and type the number.
rc_p_dims_help: In centimetres: length, width, height. The volume is worked out for you.
rc_p_inside_help: The type, then what is inside if you know.
rc_p_copies_help: Same content, same weight: recorded in one go.
rc_p_photos_title: Photograph the parcel from several angles
rc_p_photos_help: Proof of what arrived: the supplier's label, the carton's condition, the contents if it is open. The first photo is the cover.
rc_condition_title: Is the parcel in good condition?
rc_condition_help: What you see from the outside. Printed on the customer's goods receipt.
rc_photo_type: Only JPEG, PNG or WebP photos up to 10 MB are accepted
rc_how_1: Scan the customer's code, or search them by name.
rc_how_2: Say who is bringing the parcel.
rc_how_3: For each parcel: a photo, the weight, the dimensions.
rc_how_4: Finish: the labels print, the customer gets their receipt.
rc_pk_find_ph: Scan or type a package no. (PQ-…)
rc_pk_find_hint: Scan a package label to open it.
rc_pk_not_package: This is not a package number (PQ-000000)
rc_pk_is_parcel: This is a parcel label: open a package first, then scan it there.
rc_pk_empty: No package at the office. Start one, then scan the air parcels into it.
rc_pk_refused_hint: Reopen it to change its contents, or keep it sealed: it can leave with another shipment.
rc_pk_assigned_hint: To change it, the cargo team must first remove it from the shipment.
rc_pk_scan_hint: Scanner or camera: high beep = added, low beep = refused.
rc_pk_over_hint: This parcel no longer fits in this package.
rc_pk_seal_and_next: Seal this package and start another
rc_pk_empty_parcels: Empty package. Scan an air parcel label to put it in.
rc_pk_seal_help: Weigh the closed package, box included.
rc_pk_gross_under: Less than the parcels ({{kg}}): check the weighing
rc_pk_sealed_banner: Package sealed: print its label and stick it on top.
rc_pk_reopen_hint: The package becomes editable again. You will need to weigh it and print its label again.
rc_pk_delete_hint: Package {{no}} is empty: it will disappear from the list.
rc_pk_label_hint: 100 × 150 mm, to stick on top of the package. The PDF prints as is on the 4-inch label printer.
rc_scan_cam_error: The camera won't open. Use the scanner or type the number.
rc_pk_pack_proposed: Suggested: fill this package in progress first
rc_pk_pack_new_split: {{kg}}: {{count}} packages of 32 kg max, created for you
rc_pk_pack_bin_nothing: None of these parcels fit: they go into a new package.
rc_pk_pack_too_many: {{max}} parcels at most at once: pick fewer
rc_pk_pack_none: None of these parcels can go into a package.
rc_pk_pack_done_hint: Put these parcels in their carton. When it is full: weigh it and close the package, its label prints right away.
rc_pk_pack_failed_hint: The server refused each parcel: the reason is shown below.
rc_pk_pack_left_empty: {{no}} was created but is still empty: open it to delete it.
rc_pk_pack_create_failed: A new package could not be created ({{error}}): its parcels did not move.
rc_pk_why_sea: received at the warehouse: goes by sea
rc_pk_why_too_heavy: over 32 kg: travels without a package
rc_pk_todo_blocked_hint: These parcels cannot go into a package yet: the reason says what to do.
rc_pk_todo_empty: Nothing to pack: every office air parcel is in a package.
rc_pk_todo_pick: Tap the parcels to put together.
rc_pk_todo_truncated: The oldest are not shown: pack these first.
rc_pk_todo_unavailable: The list of parcels to pack is not available yet: scan the parcels into a package.
rc_pk_ready_no_room_one: {{count}} other ready parcel no longer fits ({{left}})
rc_pk_ready_no_room_other: {{count}} other ready parcels no longer fit ({{left}})
rc_pk_why_deposit_open: drop-off still being entered: finish it first
rc_pk_pack_list_error: The packages in progress could not be read: only a new package is offered. Close and reopen to retry.
rc_pk_todo_by: received by {{name}}, who can complete it
rc_pk_todo_alone_hint: Too heavy for a package: they fly on their own.
rc_dep_other_open: Being entered by {{name}}: only they can complete it.
rc_pk_todo_cargo: quote already with the customer: the cargo team corrects it
rc_dep_quote_locked: The quote for this drop-off is already with the customer (sent, paid or invoiced): to correct a parcel, ask the cargo team.
rc_dep_abandon_hint: Drop-off {{no}} has no parcel: it disappears from the day.
rc_remove_confirm_hint: The parcel is removed from this drop-off.
rc_parcel_not_found: This parcel no longer exists (removed in the meantime?).
rc_assign_to_client: Assign the drop-off to this customer
rc_done_no_client: This drop-off is waiting for its customer: it is in “Pending”. Labels print once the customer is found.
rc_pk_warehouse_note: Air packages are prepared at the office. Here at the warehouse, parcels go by sea. (Place: change it from Today.)
